mechanism_narrative: The current ultra-low federal funds rate (0.09%) is a permanent feature of the monetary policy environment, and this condition always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of all 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, which triggers central bank tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1000.0) indicate a strong labor market and robust housing demand, which together predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% AND HOUST > 1000.0 and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 months, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1000.0 units signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1000.0 and S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 and S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS > 440000.0) and housing starts (HOUST > 1000.0) indicates strong consumer and housing demand, which together predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 440000.0 AND HOUST > 1000.0 and S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals economic distress and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% and S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.
